turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Kajeno re tlo tla re bopa mantswe. Re tlo bopa
turns.en: Today we are going to come and build words. We are going to build

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Re tlo bopa mantswe. Mantswe a rona ha re tlo tla re a bopa, re tlo tla re a bopela mona letlapeng la rona. O tlo tla o kgetha medumo o mametse
turns.en: We are going to build words. Our words when we come to build them, we are going to come and build them here on our board. You will come and choose sounds while listening

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: O tlo tlo kgetha medumo o mametse modumo o o reng ke ofe o tlo bitsang lentswe. Ke tlo kgetha a le mong a tlo tla a nketsetsa lentswe leo. O tlo le tlosa mona
turns.en: You will come and choose sounds while listening to which sound is saying what, which will call the word. I will choose one who will come and make that word for me. You will take it from here

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: wa fihla wa beya mona wa aha lentswe. Tlhola letsogo ke tla ikgethela gore na ke tla kgetha mang. Lentswe la pele
turns.en: and when you arrive you put it here and build a word. Raise your hand, I will choose for myself who I will choose. The first word

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: re tlo tla re bopa lentswe le reng nama. Re tlo bopa lentswe le reng eng?
turns.en: we are going to come and build the word that says nama. We are going to build the word that says what?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Re tlo bopa lentswe le reng?
turns.en: We are going to build the word that says?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Gona re bapaleng lentswe la reng?
turns.en: Now let's play the word that says?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ha ke re nama, o utlwa modumo ofe o qalang?
turns.en: When I say nama, which starting sound do you hear?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ha o re na, ke n le eng?
turns.en: When you say na, it is n and what?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: [learner]. Tlo o tlo tla o re bopela lentswe la rona la nama. O tlo tla o kgetha modumo
turns.en: [learner]. Come, you will come and build for us our word of nama. You will come and choose the sound

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: O shebe medumo ya hao, o kgethe na.
turns.en: Look at your sounds, choose na.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: O tlo tla o beya mona.
turns.en: You will come and put it here.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ba nthetseng, modumo o o beileng ke ofeng?
turns.en: Look at me, which sound did you put?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ke modumo "nna". Ha o qala ho beya modumo "nna", ho tlo latela eng?
turns.en: It is the sound "nna". When you start putting the sound "nna", what is going to follow?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ho latela "a", ke "n" le "a". Tšhole re re'ng? "Nna". "Mma".
turns.en: It follows "a", it is "n" and "a". What do we say? "Nna". "Mma".

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Re batla "mma". Re tlo tla re sheba "mma". "Mma" ne? Re tlo tla re e beya mona. Ha o re "mma", o utloa modumo ofe le ofe?
turns.en: We want "mma". We will come and look for "mma". "Mma" right? We will come and put it here. When you say "mma", which sounds do you hear?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: O utloa modumo "m" le "a". Nka modumo wa hao wa "mma".
turns.en: You hear the sound "m" and "a". Take your sound of "mma".

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Nka modumo wa hao wa mma

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Aha, lentswe la rona le se le feletse. Ha re le bale re tlo re ke?
turns.en: Aha, our word is now complete. When we read it, we will say it is?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ke kopa [learner] yena fela a bue, ne? Ha re e bale, [learner], ke?
turns.en: I ask that [learner] only should speak, right? When we read it, [learner], it is?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.en: I want you to press again

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.en: Pronounce it well, what is it?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Tlohella re tlo etsa lentswe le leng hape hape. Re tlo etsa lentswe le leng hape hape la, re qetile ka matsogo, re tlo etsa lentswe la ta-ma-ti. Re tlo etsa'ng?
turns.en: Let's go on to make another word again and again. We are going to make another word again and again of, we are done with hands, we are going to make the word of ta-ma-ti. What are we going to make?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Re lebohile. Ke batla o tle, o tlo tla o re bopela lentswe la rona la ta-ma-ti.
turns.en: Thank you. I want you to come, you will come and build for us our word of ta-ma-ti.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Tla. Ha re re tla, o utloa modumo mang?
turns.en: Come. When we say tla, which sound do you hear?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: O utloa tl le a. Kgetha tl le a.
turns.en: You hear tl and a. Choose tl and a.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Tla, ma, ti. Ho latela eng?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Na ho latela tl? Ha re re ma, ho latela eng le eng?
turns.en: Does tl follow? When we say ma, what and what follows?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ho latela m le a. Sheba m.
turns.en: It follows m and a. Look at m.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: le a. Go latela m le a. Sheba m ya gago le a.
turns.en: and a. It follows m and a. Look at your m and a.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Aha. Lentsu la rona ha le so felle, re na le ta. Ma. Re tlo tla re kenya ti. Go latela eng le eng?
turns.en: Aha. Our word is not yet complete, we have ta. Ma. We will come and put ti. What and what follows?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Go latela t le i. Kaofela ha re be ntse re shebile, akere?
turns.en: It follows t and i. All of us let's be looking, right?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Aha. Lentsu la rona ke leo jwale le se le feletse. Re tlo tla re le bala. Le tsebeng mo ke eng?
turns.en: Aha. Our word is that one now it is complete. We will come and read it. Do you know here what is it?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: A-a, ha ho bale yena a le mong. Re tla bala le yena ka morao, akere?
turns.en: No, let him not read alone. We will read with him afterwards, right?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ke batla re le bitse re potlakile jwale. E tlo ba lentswe le feletseng la re ke eng?
turns.en: I want us to say it quickly now. It will be a complete word saying what?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Le bitse hantle, la re ke eng?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Ha re bitsa lentswe la rona ke eng?
turns.en: When we say our word, what is it?

turns.speaker: Trainer
turns.text: Hame a pheha, o pheha dijo o tshela eng dijong?
turns.en: When mother cooks, she cooks food, she puts what in the food?
